Airstrike

📍 Fatima Bint Asad School — Jabalia al-Balad, North Gaza

Full description

At approximately 02:00 on Monday, 12 May 2025, Israeli warplanes targeted Fatima Bint Asad Public Preparatory School in Jabalia al-Balad area, north of Gaza Strip as it shelters tens of displaced families. As a result, 15 people, including 8 children and 2 women, were killed, while 20 others, including 9 children and 3 women, were injured after two classrooms on the 3rd floor of the school’s western building, where the victims had sought refuge, were destroyed.
